name: Cumbres del Guadalfeo

known.via: English Wikipedia "Cumbres del Guadalfeo" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: An Andalusian vino de la tierra in the Alpujarras mountains of Granada province, formerly called Contraviesa-Alpujarra. It covers municipalities such as Albuñol, Cádiar and Ugíjar and sits one step below the DO level.
